name: postulia
description: Postulia — seguimiento de postulaciones laborales: extensión de Chrome + API propia

scripts.build: npm run build -w @postulia/shared && npm run build -w @postulia/api && npm run build -w @postulia/extension
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @postulia/api
scripts.dev:ext: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @postulia/extension
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
